snippet.title: Precursors: Armored Angels - Gameplay Demo
snippet.description:
Precursors: Armored Angels is probably one of the best turn-based strategy games of 2021. We are proud to finally bring it to the market.

Game page:
https://www.artificialworldsltd.com/store/artificialstore/item/79e20b3c-ce77-4b2f-5de5-08d93b03c130

We put our heart into making the game as good as possible and we hope that it will provide you with entertainment adequate to the work and energy put into its production.

The player has over 50 technologies to invent, over 60 mechs to build with over 120 types of various weapons. The opponent also has over 50 different types of units.

It is not possible to use all the options provided by the game in one game, so you should think carefully about each choice.

Each choice has both opportunities and consequences.

Tests have shown that the game requires a good GFX 1060 or better graphics card to look and perform as expected. Despite our significant contribution to the optimization of the game, we decided that the quality of the product must be maintained and we do not want to compromise when it comes to its appearance.
